title: Trustworthy AI-Generative Content for Intelligent Network Service: Robustness, Security, and Fairness

bias_targets.methodology: Conceptually evaluated and addressed within the proposed TrustGAIN framework; the paper outlines mitigating this bias through pre-processing, in-processing, and post-processing strategies, though it does not conduct empirical measurements.

Conceptually evaluated as a target for mitigation within the TrustGAIN framework, specifically highlighting pre-processing methods (like image augmentation) to adjust sensitive attributes such as race without empirical testing.
Discussed theoretically as a prevalent issue in large AIGC models (e.g., ChatGPT and DALL·E) that requires a multifaceted mitigation approach across different processing stages.

Incorporated conceptually as 'Location Fairness' in the architectural design and diagrams of the TrustGAIN framework (Figures 2 and 4) to evaluate regional equity, though no empirical experiments are performed.
Theoretically addressed in the pre-processing phase section, proposing data augmentation techniques to adjust sensitive demographic attributes like age to ensure fair model outputs.
